meta.name: Operation Nexus
meta.description: Synthetic demonstration dataset for SIH 2026 PS-189. No real individuals, organizations, vehicles, or locations are represented.

cases.name: Operation Nexus - Phase I
cases.description: Investigation into a suspected contraband distribution network operating across four states, initiated after a flagged shipment at a highway checkpoint.

cases.name: Operation Nexus - Phase II (Financial Trail)
cases.description: Parallel investigation into suspicious financial transfers suspected of laundering proceeds connected to Phase I, opened by a different investigating unit.

persons.name: Rajesh Kumar
persons.notes: Primary subject, Case 001. Runs a small transport brokerage as a front business.

persons.name: R. Kumar
persons.notes: Appears in an informant tip and a toll record; identity not yet confirmed to be Rajesh Kumar.

persons.name: Salim Ansari
persons.notes: Frequent contact of Phone PH0001. Suspected logistics coordinator.

persons.name: Meera Fernandes
persons.notes: Primary subject, Case 002. Manages accounts for Silverline Holdings.

evidence.description: SIM PH0001 registered to a device later linked to Rajesh Kumar via a shared recharge outlet.
42 outgoing calls from PH0001 to Salim Ansari's registered number between Aug 2-15.
Vehicle VH0010 registered under a transport permit co-signed by Salim Ansari.
ANPR camera logged VH0010 entering Riverside Industrial Estate at night, no recorded business there.
Bank teller statement places Meera Fernandes at a Riverside Industrial Estate ATM withdrawing cash for an unlisted vendor payment.
Toll camera log shows driver matching 'R. Kumar' description using vehicle VH0010 near Case 001 corridor.
Same PH0001 device briefly used a second SIM slot registered under the alias 'Raju'.
Field informant reports 'R. Kumar aka Raju' and 'Rajesh Kumar' were seen together only once, described as if the same person by two separate witnesses on different days.
